name: hud_ui_fill_bitmap_destructor_core_thunk
description: HudUiFillBitmap::DestructorCoreThunk is a pure forwarding thunk to HudUiFillBitmap::DestructorCore.

The former standalone VC5 target hud_ui_fill_bitmap_destructor_core_thunk was retired: 0x40cf50 is classified as a provider-boundary VC5 compiler/EH cleanup forwarding thunk, and current generated HUD options targets do not naturally emit the physical row without wrappers or order tricks.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x40cf50 validates a single tail jump to HudUiFillBitmap::DestructorCore at 0x4b84d0.
